title: Local operating calendars with explicit place and time
reason: Phase3 proposal only. Calendar/time is a cross-scenario hub for market years, FX dates and environmental observations. High demand but low current accepted demo coverage keeps it behind initial geography/catalogue bridges. GOVUK has three divisions, not one UK calendar; region mapping and historical coverage are missing. tzdb civil rules must be evaluated by maintained runtime library; source-rule rows are not fixed offsets. CLDR Windows mapping may be one-to-many. Browser local timezone is not source timezone. Existing historical demos cannot be made compatible by moving their dates.
practical_value: 74.0/100 proposal value; readiness gated independently. I connect dated activity plus an explicitly declared jurisdiction/timezone; review date-only versus instant semantics; choose a local-calendar enrichment; see coverage gaps before comparing activity on working days or holidays.
showcase_value: 4/5, excluded from practical score; Which transactions fall on declared regional bank holidays?
